summary: In this excerpt from the novel's Book 6, the characters discuss Dr. Xiaohu Zhang, an NSA mathematician who knew Professor Halliday from Berkeley and whom Pilar vouches for as a good family man. Checker argues the NSA will eventually have to be involved because it has far more resources for finding Professor Sonya than the Pasadena police, and the stolen proof about a possible economic apocalypse cannot be recovered. Arthur decides Pilar should approach Zhang first, asks that Russell and Checker be kept out of it, and plans to inspect the SUV that tried to kill them now held in police impound.
one_line: Characters weigh bringing the NSA into the search for Professor Sonya, with Pilar sent to approach NSA mathematician Dr. Xiaohu Zhang.
key_facts: Dr. Xiaohu Zhang has a PhD from Berkeley and has worked as a mathematician for the NSA for almost twenty years.
Pilar says Zhang and Professor Halliday likely know each other from back at Berkeley.
Pilar describes Zhang as having nothing irregular in his bank accounts, a wife, three kids, and volunteer work planting trees and coaching Little League.
Checker describes the NSA as a government spy organization that has far too much power and far too little oversight.
Pilar says Zhang is not involved, and suggests he could be someone Arthur goes to for help.
The narrator argues Zhang will not be the one calling the shots because his bosses will take the matter out of his hands.
Checker points out that the police have already been called in and that the NSA will likely be involved sooner or later.
Checker says the NSA has far more resources for finding Professor Sonya than the Pasadena PD.
Checker notes the proof of the possible economic apocalypse was stolen before the group arrived on the scene and cannot be put back.
Arthur says Sonya's safety is his only concern and he would rather she be in trouble with the Feds than hurt.
Zhang took the day off because he is chaperoning his daughter's class trip to the tar pits.
Arthur tells Pilar to go talk to Zhang first, be honest, and say that he is on his way but sent her ahead.
Arthur asks that Russell and Checker be left out of the conversation with Zhang so they can keep working without government attention.
Checker reports that the SUV that tried to kill them has been taken to police impound.
Arthur says he will pull strings to get access to inspect the SUV.
The narrator asks for Cas's help with van tracking.
